title: Serializable isolation by default
statement: The system shall execute every transaction, including single-statement and cross-shard transactions, at serializable isolation regardless of session or client settings.
rationale: PO decision: serializable by default. Jepsen found weak defaults undercutting advertised guarantees.

acceptance_criteria.text: No session or client option can lower isolation below serializable; attempts return a configuration error.

A Jepsen-style test (network partitions, node crashes, clock skew, membership changes and shard splits) runs for at least 1 hour per release and an Elle-style checker finds zero serializability anomalies.
